# Generated by tools/m10_second_century.py --write; AD 97-199 situations.

# Trajan's Dacian Wars; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9; UNE-DAC
antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	content_trigger = {
		tag = XAA
	}
	can_start = {
		current_date >= 101.1.1
		current_date < 107.1.1
		country_exists = c:XAA
	}
	can_end = {
		OR = {
			current_date >= 107.1.1
			var:antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_resolution_progress >= 100
		}
	}
	visible = {
		country_exists = c:XAA
	}
	tooltip = {
		custom_tooltip = "antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_tooltip"
	}
	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { owner ?= c:XAA }
			value = owner.country_color
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_legend"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}
	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_resolution_progress value = 0 }
		c:XAA = { trigger_event_non_silently = antq_m10_second.2002 }
	}
	on_monthly = {
		c:XAA = {
			if = {
				limit = { stability >= 20 at_war = no }
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_resolution_progress add = 2.5 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { stability >= 0 at_war = yes }
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_resolution_progress add = 1.75 } }
			}
			else = {
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_resolution_progress add = 0.5 } }
			}
			random_list = {
				1 = {
					add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -0.25 }
					add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -0.15 }
					capital = { province = { change_province_food_percentage = -0.005 } }
					add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
				}
				23 = {}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_resolution_progress >= 25 NOT = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_25 } }
			set_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_25
			c:XAA ?= { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_resolution_progress >= 50 NOT = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_50 } }
			set_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_50
			c:XAA ?= { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_resolution_progress >= 75 NOT = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_75 } }
			set_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_75
			c:XAA ?= { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
		}
	}
	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_resolution_progress >= 100 }
			c:XAA ?= {
				add_army_tradition = army_tradition_weak_bonus
				add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
			}
		}
		else = {
			c:XAA ?= {
				add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_resolution_progress } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_resolution_progress }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_25 } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_25 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_50 } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_50 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_75 } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_trajan_dacia_milestone_75 }
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_resolution_progress value = 0 }
		c:XAA = { trigger_event_non_silently = antq_m10_second.2012 }
	}
	on_monthly = {
		c:XAA = {
			if = {
				limit = { stability >= 20 at_war = no }
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_resolution_progress add = 2.5 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { stability >= 0 at_war = yes }
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_resolution_progress add = 1.75 } }
			}
			else = {
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_resolution_progress add = 0.5 } }
			}
			random_list = {
				1 = {
					add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -0.25 }
					add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -0.15 }
					capital = { province = { change_province_food_percentage = -0.005 } }
					add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
				}
				23 = {}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_resolution_progress >= 25 NOT = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_25 } }
			set_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_25
			c:XAA ?= { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_resolution_progress >= 50 NOT = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_50 } }
			set_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_50
			c:XAA ?= { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_resolution_progress >= 75 NOT = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_75 } }
			set_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_75
			c:XAA ?= { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
		}
	}
	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_resolution_progress >= 100 }
			c:XAA ?= {
				add_army_tradition = army_tradition_weak_bonus
				add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
			}
		}
		else = {
			c:XAA ?= {
				add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_resolution_progress } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_resolution_progress }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_25 } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_25 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_50 } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_50 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_75 } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_verus_parthia_milestone_75 }
	}
}

# Marcomannic Wars; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9
antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	content_trigger = {
		tag = XAA
	}
	can_start = {
		current_date >= 166.1.1
		current_date < 181.1.1
		country_exists = c:XAA
	}
	can_end = {
		OR = {
			current_date >= 181.1.1
			var:antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_resolution_progress >= 100
		}
	}
	visible = {
		country_exists = c:XAA
	}
	tooltip = {
		custom_tooltip = "antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_tooltip"
	}
	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { owner ?= c:XAA }
			value = owner.country_color
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_legend"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}
	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_resolution_progress value = 0 }
		c:XAA = { trigger_event_non_silently = antq_m10_second.2015 }
	}
	on_monthly = {
		c:XAA = {
			if = {
				limit = { stability >= 20 at_war = no }
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_resolution_progress add = 2.5 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { stability >= 0 at_war = yes }
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_resolution_progress add = 1.75 } }
			}
			else = {
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_resolution_progress add = 0.5 } }
			}
			random_list = {
				1 = {
					add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -0.25 }
					add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -0.15 }
					capital = { province = { change_province_food_percentage = -0.005 } }
					add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
				}
				23 = {}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_resolution_progress >= 25 NOT = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_milestone_25 } }

			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_resolution_progress >= 50 NOT = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_milestone_50 } }
			set_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_milestone_50
			c:XAA ?= { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_resolution_progress >= 75 NOT = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_milestone_75 } }
			set_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_milestone_75
			c:XAA ?= { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
		}
	}
	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { var:antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_resolution_progress >= 100 }
			c:XAA ?= {
				add_army_tradition = army_tradition_weak_bonus
				add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
			}
		}
		else = {
			c:XAA ?= {
				add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_resolution_progress } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_resolution_progress }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_milestone_25 } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_milestone_25 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_milestone_50 } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_milestone_50 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_milestone_75 } remove_variable = antq_m10_second_marcomannic_wars_milestone_75 }
	}
